title: MATERIALS FOR SUSTAINABLE ATMOSPHERIC RE-ENTRY - EXPRO+
description: Objective:To characterise spacecraft materials that minimise atmospheric impacts during re-entry.Description:ESA's Green Agendaand Ecodesign Policy require that the environmental impacts of all space missions andprogrammes are assessed and reduced across their full life cycle. Launch and spacecraft re-entry effects onthe atmosphere are known gaps to fulfil these requirements. This results in significant uncertainty andsystematic exclusion of such effects when developing materials on the basis of sustainable performance.Previous and ongoing Discovery activities, Insights into the Chemistry of Atmospheric Re-entry of JunkedSpacecraft (ICARUS) and Impacts of space Debris ablation on Earth's Atmospheric System (IDEAS), havehighlighted the potential importance of ablation products in the atmosphere while established initial modellingapproaches and experimental validation capabilities.The proposed activity addresses this critical knowledge gap by developing a consolidated experimental andmodelling framework to characterise emissionsfrom spacecraft re-entry and integrate these into atmosphericand design assessment tools. This will enable the incorporation of atmospheric impacts into Life CycleAssessment (LCA) and support both Ecodesign and Design-for-Demise (D4D) decision making. Such aframework would be the first worldwide.The activity encompasses the following tasks:- Identify representative launcher and spacecraftdemise-critical materials as well as Space Debris Particles(SPSs)- Propose material characterization factors (e.g. Ozon Depletionmetrics, radiative forcing proxies) andassociated quantification methodology- Refine methods to allow observation and characterization of particles generated during the vaporizationphase of selected materials- Demonstrate validation tests under realistic atmospheric re-entry conditions (e.g. Thermal, pressure andflow conditions) measuring and linking ablation fluxes to downstream chemical compositions- Parametrization and modelling of datasets for integration into re-entry and atmospheric chemistryclimatemodels-Define uncertainty and applicability ranges for model use- Formulate recommendations for standardised testing procedures to support the continuous developmentand population of material datasets.Procurement Policy: C(3) = Activity restricted to SME RD organisations, preferably in cooperation. For additional information please go to:http://www.esa.int/About_Us/Business_with_ESA/Small_and_Medium_Sized_Enterprises/Opportunities_for_SMEs/Procurement_policy_on_fair_access_for_SMEs_-_the_C1-C4_Clauses

title: Star analyzer (200ln/mm)
description:
Diametru conexiune 1,25” Acoperire antireflex completă INFORMATII Acum Star analizer poate arăta astronomilor amatori lucruri uimitoare despre univers la un preț acceptabil. Spre deosebire de filtrele de 1,25”, acesta este accesoriul ideal pentru camerele CCD astronomice, webcam și camere video. De exemplu, cu un telescop cu o apertură de doar 80mm și o cameră web simplă, nemodificată, caracteristicile ascunse a sute de stele până la magnitudinea 4 se pot vedea. Cu o apertură de 200mm și o cameră CCD sensibilă, este posibilă identificarea novelor sau supernovelor sau chiar măsurarea expansiunii universului prin deplasarea către roșu a quasarilor. Principalele caracteristici: - transmisie ridicată a sticlei speciale montate în cadru standard de 1,25”. - sticlă cu acoperire anti-reflex ce are și rol de protecție. - design eficient cu 100 linii/mm. - ușor de folosit, se înfiletează în adaptorul ocularului ca un filtru normal. - un inel de blocaj menține orientarea. - optimizat pentru senzori CCD de mici dimensiuni ce se găsesc în webcam-uri obișnuite. - steaua și spectrul ei pot fi înregistrate în aceeași imagine, ceea ce ajută la identificare și calibrare. - se poate monta la un ocular obișnuit pentru observații vizuale

title: Belgium – Environmental services – Support for the implementation of the EU pledge on three billion additional trees by 2030
description: The EU pledge for three billion additional trees in the EU was announced in 2020 (EU Biodiversity Strategy). The implementation of the pledge depends greatly on initiatives at national and subnational level. A roadmap for its implementation with milestones was published in 2021 (EU Forest Strategy). Building on the accomplished milestones (https://environment.ec.europa.eu/strategy/biodiversity-strategy-2030/3-billion-trees_en), the contractor will further promote the implementation of the EU pledge. In particular, it will promote the uptake of the pledge by liaising with potentially interested stakeholders (public and private organisations of land and forest owners, foresters, national and sub-national authorities) in all Member States; it will organise webinars and seminars/conferences; it will support the Commission on the outreach and organisation of the yearly three billion trees award.

title: Set scolar individual
description:
Set scolar individual anti-scolioza cu polita pe teava rotunda, reglabil pentru grupuri № 4-6 Banca scolara individuala anti-scolioza cu polita pe teava rotunda, reglabila Dimensiuni (Lungime x latime): 700х585 mm. Greutatea: 12,60 kg. Inaltime reglabila : 640-700-760 mm. Blatul este realizat din PAL melaminat de 18 mm cu cant din ABS de 1,00 mm de culoare fag. Partea frontala si polita sunt realizate din PAL melaminat de 16 mm de culoare fag. Banca scolara este dotata cu o polita pentru depozitare si cu un agatator de ghiozdan. Blatul de lucru anti-scolioza este format din 2 parti: blat orizontal, pe care sunt montate compartimentul pentru pixuri si suportul de pahar, si blatul de lucru avand unghiul de inclinare de 7°. Blatul bancii este neted cu colturi rotunjite si cu margine decorativa, fixat de profile metalice prin intermediul unor suruburi ascunse. Profilele bancii sunt confectionate din tevi rotunde de metal cu diametrul de 25 mm se imbina telescopic cu marimea de 32 mm cu grosimea de 1,2 mm , zona de imbinare fiind ermetica, acoperita cu garnituri din plastic sigure, fixate in procesul de reglare. Profilele bancii sunt vopsite in cimp electrostatic si polimerizat si sunt prevazute cu garnituri din plastic rezistent, fixate la ambele capete, pentru a asigura protecţia pardoselii. Culoare blat : fag, galben/ lamaie verde, sakura/ lavanda, jasmin. Culoarea cadru: verde, galben, gri. Termen de garantie: 24 luni. Scaun scolar HPL pe teava rotunda, reglabil Dimensiune spa
